review_scope: Independent scientific acceptance review of prices and collection-level readiness; not independent review of my numerical producer code.
critical_researcher_decisions: Select explicit market/operator identities and bounded historical price intervals, with a stated evidence standard for interval completeness and independent corroboration.
Resolve or transparently exclude Pune2023price disagreement and MNGL overnight/midnight/calendar ambiguities; do not silently assign a day.
Define historical feature-availability eligibility. Unknown release vintages must not be replaced by assumed one-month lags or a retrieval date.
Choose the H2 study window and permissible sources, or acknowledge H2 is infeasible/inconclusive for the present corpus; corporate exact bytes do not establish historical public availability.

Approve factor-specific exclusions and practical stopping decisions for still-uncollected VAHAN, company procurement/sourcing, legal tax/tariff histories and other candidate factors. Failed attempts alone are not proof of irrecoverability.
Review a cumulative Stage3completion report and checksum-frozen candidate snapshot before explicitly accepting it.
important_distinctions: Monthly target arithmetic belongs in Stage4, but Stage3must first establish the eligible underlying price paths and source-date uncertainty.
Unknown publication dates do not automatically invalidate retrospective outcome labels; they do invalidate unqualified use of historical predictor information unless availability is established.
Five city quotes in one news event are not five independent market-regime validations.
National CNG sales are not city-level demand; station reported indicators with unknown flow/stock definition cannot be used as operating-station stock.
A limited, explicitly qualified accepted subset may be defensible after researcher review; row counts and passing extraction checks do not create acceptance automatically.
limitations: I independently checked the six listed structural/raw-source conditions and recomputed the listed counts.
I did not personally verify every source page, every historical price change, all PDF facts or every publication timestamp.
I did not rerun target aggregation or modeling, and no Stage4work was performed.
